boundary: cached_verify_nanoseconds / repetitions; setup, process and lifecycle walls remain separate
relativeScope: All ratios are paired within one process and mode; absolute denominators and ranges are retained.
setupQualification: Corpus read is once per process. Decode, admission, Cached construction and its nested context/precompute components are separately instrumented. Explicit warm verification is outside the cached timer and outside cache_total; it is not separately instrumented. Process wall includes startup/warm/output; lifecycle wall additionally includes provenance/readiness/cleanup. Components are not summed as independent setup totals.
